messages.subject: error in plot
parts:
Hi Chris, I am running the same code I've used in the past.  But, get this error code on plotting:

 plot(mgaz)
Error in plot.new() : figure margins too large

These are the packages I've loaded:
library(move)
library(shiny)
library(lazyeval)

library(reshape2)
library(ctmm)
library(rgdal)
library(sp)
library(ggplot2)

Any idea why I can't get 'plot' to work?

Thanks, Nanette.

messages.subject: Re: error in plot
parts:
Hi Nanette,

I would try increasing the size of the plotting panel in RStudio, or increasing your display resolution, or plotting directly to a file.

Best,
Chris
